answer: I ran the 3-qubit GHZ circuit on sirius:mock with 200 shots. The circuit was H on q0, CNOT q0 to q1, CNOT q1 to q2, then a measurement of all 3 qubits. Job 01a15fa0-2576-744a-bc08-a2168331bc05 completed with counts {"000": 200}. The bit order is c0 c1 c2. The helper transpiled the circuit for the Sirius star topology into 5 r gates, 2 cz gates, 4 move gates, and 3 measurements. The mock is a simulator stand-in, so it does not give real GHZ statistics. Every shot came back as 000, and you should not read that as a physics result. The API reported 1.0 billed second, and the helper estimated 0 credits because this was a mock run. The scratch files are /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_3612af23-e49-44/ghz3.qasm and /Users/claytonchancey/Desktop/quantum/.claude/worktrees/wf_3612af23-e49-44/run_ghz.py.
